steps.name: build the signed packages from the committed source
signature, exact file set, and tamper refusal
preflight refuses an occupied port and a non-empty root
install: runtime, PostgreSQL cluster, migrations, accounts, startup task, services, first verified backup
installed facts: listeners, secret ACL, mode, least privilege, task registration
crash recovery: worker/web killed, then the supervisor itself killed with live children, then started again
installed operational journey (45 test patients, certified release, outbound RES/PDF/backup) over HTTPS
verified encrypted backup of the working installation
restore into a new quarantined database; the live installation is untouched
upgrade refused/failed safely: tampered package, failing migration, release that cannot start
upgrade 1.0.0 → 1.1.0: pre-upgrade backup, forward migration, switch, health, data intact
rollback gate: database newer than the previous release → refused, nothing changes
application-only upgrade 1.1.0 → 1.1.1 and compatible rollback back to 1.1.0
disaster recovery: an older backup is NOT activatable over changed work; a fresh backup is restored and activated (source fenced, health, data equal)
stop is graceful (worker over IPC) and start recovers; no listener remains after stop
uninstall keeps data by default, then removes everything on explicit request; no process or listener remains
the installed CLI can remove its own installation (it runs from inside the root)

notRun: elevated SYSTEM startup task (session not Administrator)
NAS backup target and key escrow
